summary.text: Second-generation Titan son of Crius and Eurybia, consort of Eos and father by her of the strong winds and the stars that crown heaven.

story.text: Bright Eurybia, daughter of Pontus, was joined in love with Crius and bore great Astraeus beside Pallas and Perses. Pseudo-Apollodorus preserves the same three sons in his genealogy of the younger Titan house.

Eos bore to Astraeus the strong-hearted winds: brightening Zephyrus, headlong Boreas and Notus. After them she bore Eosphorus, the Dawn-bringer, and the gleaming stars with which heaven is crowned. Pseudo-Apollodorus compresses the brood to winds and stars, while Hyginus adds Favonius to the named winds.
